body:
Declared types versus database truth. Expr[T] is a concrete generic expression carrying rendering behavior and optional column metadata. Col[T] declares the Go type; it does not inspect a database. Bind couples that type to a destination pointer. schema.Col adds a check against declared schema metadata, not against the live catalogue. This distinction matters because compiler success does not establish that a deployed schema matches the declaration.

Evidence: ds:block?id=typed-expression-bpqvb4a9; ds:block?id=column-declaration-gthk6bb2; ds:block?id=schema-types-r4ut75bs. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md.
